title: Toradora!: SOS! Hurray for Foodies
synopsis: Toradora DVD shorts featuring the miniature forms of the Toradora characters talking about, and eating, food.
search_text: toradora sos hurray for foodies とらト ラ sos special finished

episodes.title: Toradora SOS!
episodes.synopsis: When Ami complains about having to eat tarako spaghetti, Ryuji decides to take her to try some delicious tarako, competing with Minori's spaghetti bolognese.

episodes.title: Toradora SOS! 2
episodes.synopsis: Ryuji and Minori have another food duel, this time involving purin.

episodes.title: Toradora SOS! 3
episodes.synopsis: When Yuri feels down after a failed attempt at getting a date, the gang takes her to the restaurant when Ryuji and Minori have a battle over curry. However, Minori's choice of curry is too hot for the girls to handle.

episodes.title: Toradora SOS! 4
episodes.synopsis: Taiga, Ryuji and Minori follow Ami around the convenience store, where she buys copious amounts of corned beef.
